newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso ends firm on long dollar sale.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso ends firm on long dollar sale.

text.p: The Mexican peso reversed early weakness at the close on Monday after dealers decided to sell long dollar positions, traders said.

"The way the market opened, it looked like the peso would hit the eight-per-dollar market, but the opposite happened," a dealer said. "It seems banks sold off part of the long (dollar) positions, as there was no real capital inflow." The
benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour stablemate ended 2.0 and 2.1 centavos firmer, respectively, at 7.9400/7.9430 and 7.9360/7.9390 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had earlier closed 3.2 centavos firmer at 7.9700/7.9740 per dollar.
